# Perplexity API Changelog — captured 2026-08-07
Prior cache (2026-07-07): auto-executing `mcp` remote connector was reference-only, no dated launch.

## July 2026 [NEW — REPORTED]
- **Gateway API** — unified API gateway with **OpenAI Chat Completions and Anthropic Messages
  compatibility**, automatic health-based routing across model deployments. No per-request fee;
  per-token pricing only.
- **Remote MCP server GA-hosted at `https://api.perplexity.ai/mcp`** — cloud-hosted, no local install.
  Streamable HTTP + Bearer API key. Three tools: Search API web search; conversational AI backed by the
  Agent API `fast` preset; deep research backed by the Agent API `high` preset. This resolves the
  2026-07-07 "reference-only, no dated launch" watch item.
  https://docs.perplexity.ai/docs/getting-started/integrations/mcp-server
- MCP Server 1.0 migration: off legacy Sonar models onto Agent API presets; adds progress streaming
  for long-running research.
- Agent API model expansion: Claude Opus 5, full GPT-5.6 family (Sol/Terra/Luna), Gemini 3.6 Flash,
  Grok 4.5, Kimi K3. GPT-5.6 Sol priority tier via service_tier:"priority".
- Enhanced inline citations in the Agent API ([web:1] source typing).
- Sonar Chat Completions fully consolidated into the Agent API. [consolidation]

Updated: 2026-08-07 — Watching tier. Two items clear the bar (Gateway API, hosted remote MCP server).
